confidence_notes: Food anchors use a Fethiye aggregate closest to July 2026, with a limited contributor base. Cocktail and wine prices are inferred from the local beer relationship; July accommodation values are broad peak-season estimates.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink use Fethiye city-level prices. Accommodation is modeled for a Turkish Mediterranean resort town, with Antalya and Marmaris as loose comparables.
